summary: High Court conviction reversal; reliability of PW1 testimony disputed; absence of fingerprint evidence; unexamined material witnesses; prior enmity relevance; reputation as internal fact under Evidence Act s.3; appellate reappreciation standards; murder conviction upheld, rape and theft set aside; attempt to rape and house breaking upheld; High Court error in relying on unsupported reputation assessment.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court conviction for murder, attempt to rape and house breaking set aside; acquittal restored.
